propositions: Hand-rolled argument parsing loops in claim.py (_parse_force, _parse_assignee) and transition.py (_parse_flags) must be replaced with stdlib argparse while preserving all load-bearing behavioral quirks including None-vs-empty-string sentinels and token-consumption semantics.

--force bare form must consume following non-option tokens in claim but not in transition; transition force_reason is None when absent, "" when bare (no consumption), and <reason> when --force=<reason> is explicit.
--assignee ABSENT maps to None (triggers default_assignee fallback) while explicit empty string "" clears the assignee; value-less flag at end must exit 1.

Unknown/extra CLI tokens must be silently skipped via parse_known_args; prefixed abbreviations like --for/--reas must not match full spellings; --help remains byte-exact from golden files (dispatcher-served, not parser-generated).

Retired --force-close flag must trigger pre/post-parse exit-1 rejection with bespoke message; transition._parse_flags shim must be retained to serve three external direct callers with identical 5-tuple return value (reason, force_reason, close_class, caused_by, ref).
All exit codes (1 for value-less flags, 10 for ConcurrencyError) and CLI interface tests must remain unchanged after the refactor to argparse.
